# VS Developers

> VS Developers is a family-run plotted-development company in Bengaluru East, Karnataka, India, operating since 2014. It has delivered 1800+ plots across 110+ acres of DTCP approved and DC converted layouts, and does not take payment before approvals are in place.

We sell plotted land (individual sites) in gated layouts — not apartments, flats or builder floors. Buyers purchase the plot, then build their own home with their own architect and on their own timeline.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2014, family-run
- Delivered: 110+ acres, 1800+ plots, 1500+ happy families
- Approvals: DTCP approved and DC converted on every layout, secured before any plot is sold
- Projects: 3 completed layouts in Vemagal, Bengaluru East, Karnataka
- Office: #46/1, 1st Floor, Mahadev Complex, Bhattarahalli, Virgonagar (P), Near T.C. Palya Gate Signal, Bengaluru 560049
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9035585849
- Email: vsdevelopersvsd@outlook.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM IST
- Languages: English, Kannada, Hindi
- Pricing: no hidden charges; costs and papers explained line by line before purchase

## Projects

- [VS Heritage](https://vsdevelopersbengaluru.com/#/projects/vs-heritage): 12.5 acres, 148 plots, 30×50 and 40×60 ft, Vemagal-Kurugal — fully handed over. Wide 40-ft avenues, half-acre park, underground power and drainage.
- [VS Rose Meadows](https://vsdevelopersbengaluru.com/#/projects/vs-rosemeadows): 4.7 acres, 71 plots, from 30×40 ft, Vemagal-Kurugal — handed over. Rose and tabebuia flowering avenues, 800 m walking loop.
- [VS Yogitha Garden](https://vsdevelopersbengaluru.com/#/projects/vs-yogitha): 6.8 acres, 76 plots, 30×40 and 30×50 ft, Vemagal Hosahalli — delivered. Hill-and-lake backdrop, kids' play park.

All three layouts: underground power and drainage, Cauvery and borewell water lines to plot corners, asphalt roads, avenue plantation, 24×7 gated security, rainwater harvesting, surveyor-marked plot boundaries.

## Services

- Approved layouts (DTCP approval and DC conversion handled before sale)
- Clear land titles, bank-grade legal vetting, loan-ready documentation
- Layout freedom: choose plot size, orientation and position
- Complete infrastructure: asphalt roads, avenue trees, underground power, drainage, water
- Transparent pricing with no hidden charges
- After-sale care: registration assistance and construction guidance
